AI Software Delivery Platform — best-of-breed modules (CD/CI, IaC, IDP, testing, AppSec, FinOps) unified by Harness AI.

Booth flyer from Building for Production (2026-06-02). “Best-of-breed modules unified by Harness AI.” Saved to research further. — www.harness.io/demo

Modules:

  • DevOps for Velocity: Continuous Delivery, Continuous Integration, Infrastructure as Code, Internal Developer Portal, Database DevOps, Artifact Registry
  • Testing for Reliability: Feature Management & Experimentation, Resilience Testing, AI SRE, AI Test Automation
  • AppSec for Security: Application Security Testing, Web Application & API Protection, AI Security
  • FinOps for Efficiency: Cloud Cost Management, Software Engineering Insights

Harness AI layer: Agentic Flows (multiple agents) → Software Delivery Knowledge Graph → Intelligent Workflow Orchestration.

How is the platform different?

  • AI for Smarter & Safer DevSecOps — create/maintain compliant pipelines in minutes; offload testing, triage, and RCA to AI; ship safely with AI-verified releases.
  • Modular Platform — choose best-of-breed modules, combine for an integrated experience, 100+ integrations.
  • Enterprise Scale — standardize using Harness templates, scale pipelines as needed, reduce maintenance burden by 90%+.
  • Embedded Security & Governance — org-wide guardrails via Policy-as-Code, human-in-the-loop through Approvals, fine-grained RBAC.
